items.title: Vanderbilt University hit by cyberattack, BYOD group reportedly claims it
items.summary: Vanderbilt confirmed outages across devices, systems and cloud services on Nov 9; the BYOD group appears to have claimed it, and Vanderbilt Health says hospital and clinical operations were not affected.

items.title: UNM Health incident: BYOD claims ~36,000 systems
items.summary: UNM Health calls the incident, which began Oct 26, a cybersecurity event and has not confirmed ransomware; BYOD's claim of about 36,000 compromised machines is unverified.

items.title: University Hospitals (Cleveland) systems still offline after Oct 22 incident
items.summary: Systems were still offline in a Nov 2 update while hospitals stayed open; ransomware has not been publicly disclosed and no group has claimed it.

items.title: Medi Porta (Chur, Switzerland) ransomware attack
items.summary: Listed as a Nov 6 ransomware attack that exposed sensitive data on local storage systems; medical care continued.

items.title: Ridgecrest Regional Hospital disruption
items.summary: Phone and computer systems at the California hospital were disrupted by a suspected attack; scope remains unclear.

items.title: Q3 2026 ransomware claims up ~23% quarter on quarter
items.summary: Q3 2026 recorded 2,865 ransomware victim claims, up from 2,325 the previous quarter.

ransomware.note: Few November victims are confirmed yet; leak-site claims typically lag attacks by weeks. Several healthcare items are unconfirmed as ransomware.

items.title: Major Microsoft 365 outage: Exchange Online, Teams, Intune, Copilot, Defender
items.summary: Starting ~18:00 UTC Nov 12, servers failing automated health checks took down Outlook/Exchange Online, Teams, Intune and admin tools; partial recovery was unstable into Nov 13 with no full ETA (incidents EX1550543 / MO1550821).

items.title: AWS/Cloudflare Downdetector spikes were downstream of Microsoft
items.summary: About 1,350 AWS reports on Downdetector during the M365 event; the AWS Health Dashboard showed only a local Tokyo issue and Cloudflare Radar was clean.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b (London) power and generator failure
items.summary: On Oct 20, a third-party facility hosting the zone lost utility power and a controller fault stopped the backup generators from taking over.

outage.note: The M365 incident is the dominant event of the past 24 hours; the Google Cloud London item is October background.

items.title: CISA adds four exploited flaws to KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex
items.summary: Added Nov 9 after confirmed active exploitation, with a Nov 12 federal remediation deadline; attackers and the number of victims are not identified.

items.title: CISA warns of active exploitation of critical Node2Shell flaw
items.summary: CISA says hackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure KEV entries hit Nov 13 deadline
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws on the KEV catalog carry a Nov 13 federal patch deadline.

items.title: Metabase, Windows and Cisco Secure Firewall flaws added to KEV
items.summary: The Metabase zero-day let unauthenticated attackers gain admin access and exfiltrate data.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 switch zero-day used to take over 996 devices
items.summary: A Nov 4 briefing says attackers used a new zero-day to take over 996 Zyxel GS1900 switches.

items.title: Marathon Health notifying ~5.7M people of breach
items.summary: An attacker impersonated an IT worker and stole employee credentials; it is not described as ransomware.

items.title: Cisco zero-days prompt CISA emergency directive with Five Eyes partners
items.summary: CISA issued an emergency directive over exploited Cisco zero-days, coordinated with Five Eyes agencies.

items.title: M 6.4 earthquake, 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands
items.summary: USGS green alert on Nov 9 with no tsunami flagged.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India
items.summary: Murasu made landfall Nov 3, the second cyclone to hit the coast in under a week.

items.title: Severe storms in Santa Catarina, Brazil
items.summary: 671 storm-related incidents across 76 municipalities were logged on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Ecuador flooding leaves 12 dead
items.summary: Media reports put deaths from heavy rain and flooding across Ecuador at 12 as of Nov 5.

items.title: Northern Mexico rains: 2 dead, 450 homes affected
items.summary: Weekend rain across four northern states left 2 dead and 45 people rescued, per a Nov 2 report.

physical.note: No significant November 2026 wildfire reports were found.
